text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That race was ultra-lucky! I took 1st 
place! A huge upset victory~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aww, as expected of you, Trainer! As 
expected of Lady Shiraoki! And as expected 
of...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I am truly beloved by God...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! It wouldn't be an exaggeration to 
say I have no rivals left~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Man, what great news! Which means...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please take this as my thanks!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A celebratory pun on sea bream... It's a 
charm that lets you remove sea bream bones 
cleanly!!

...I gladly accepted the thought behind 
it, at least!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah! O-of course I understand~! 
I'm not riding it, not riding it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally riding a wave of good luck 
though~! Ehehe~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Being able to ride it so well is all 
thanks to your guidance, Trainer! So with 
that said...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please take this as my thanks!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Playing on "riding the waves"... It's a 
lucky charm to help you befriend a 
surfer!!

...I gladly accepted the thought behind 
it, at least!
